title: Mechanical watch stopped by the emitter

tellings.quote: it was like a mechanical watch that just stopped.

plain: Between 1987 and 1989, at S4, a secret site in Nevada, a mechanical watch is said to have simply stopped near an emitter, a device Bob Lazar says came from an alien craft he worked on there. The researcher Luigi Vendittelli repeats this from Lazar after spending two days with him, as an example of the strange effects the device is said to have had.
